human_run_rule: non-ticking state -> dispatch directly; ticking + reconcile().queued -> 202 {queued,reason,detail}; dispatch None -> set_rollback(True) (clock untouched, verified called) + 409 (distinct messages per flow); else 201 serialized run
detail_rule: 404 masks missing+forbidden; single-row carries error_diagnostic=classify_run_error; include_events=='1' appends events ordered by seq [:500] (any other value incl. '0' omits)
cancel_rule: reason=(body.reason or 'cancelled by user')[:512] for the ROW; cloud RUNNING + cancel_requested_at NULL -> 202 stamp-only fast path (dup -> 200 locked branch, worker finalizes); terminal -> 409 run_already_terminal; local w/ runner + not QUEUED/PAUSED -> CANCEL_REQUESTED (queue dropped) + on_commit {v:1,type:cancel,run_id,reason=FULL untruncated body}; else finalize CANCELLED {cancel_requested_at,cancel_reason,error_code:cancelled,error:reason}; send failures (RunnerOfflineError/generic) swallowed+logged
